parts:
Hi Linxuan Ma,

From your error output the issue is with input argument 26 of the call to the fortran microclimate code (see the list below) - that would be your tides table - try turning off the intertidal simulation by making shore = 0 and hopefully it runs, and so you need to investigate your tide table to see what's wrong. And re the rock issue, the option for rock is only in micro_global and it just does this:

      BulkDensity <- Density
      cap=0
      runmoist <- 0
      PE <- rep(CampNormTbl9_1[1,4],19) #air entry potential J/kg
      KS <- rep(CampNormTbl9_1[1,6],19) #saturated conductivity, kg s/m3
      BB <- rep(CampNormTbl9_1[1,5],19) #soil 'b' parameter
      BD <- rep(BulkDensity,19) # soil bulk density, Mg/m3
      DD <- rep(Density,19) # soil density, Mg/m3

So for rock you make sure the bulk density is the same as the density (try just a tiny bit lower - can't remember if problems arise if they are exactly the same), turn off the soil moisture model and choose the mineral soil properties (Thcond, SpecHeat, Density) to match your rock type.

All the best,
Mike

Mike

Hi Mike,
Apologies for the late reply, although I saw your prompt reply early on, I have spent some time in fieldwork recently. Thank you very much, with your reply and my browsing through the code, I have solved the problem very well. 
There are a few reasons why this issue arose (which may be helpful to others): I initially made the mistake of putting the demdata for the broad region directly into micro_era5, instead of calculating it separately based on the small-scale layer for each locus. In addition, I only updated NicheMapR to the latest version and neglected to update Microclima, and older versions of get_dem get results in the format of RasterLayer rather than SpatRaster, which, while not affecting the runing of the micro_era5 function that uses the network to download the dems, interfered somewhat with my understanding of the local dem data import judgment. Then, the Elevation data from worldclim is not in a format that can be used directly in the micro_era5 function, and needs to be adjusted further to be consistent.
Best wishes,

Hi Linxuan Ma,

From your error output the issue is with input argument 26 of the call to the fortran microclimate code (see the list below) - that would be your tides table - try turning off the intertidal simulation by making shore = 0 and hopefully it runs, and so you need to investigate your tide table to see what's wrong. And re the rock issue, the option for rock is only in micro_global and it just does this:

      BulkDensity <- Density
      cap=0
      runmoist <- 0
      PE <- rep(CampNormTbl9_1[1,4],19) #air entry potential J/kg
      KS <- rep(CampNormTbl9_1[1,6],19) #saturated conductivity, kg s/m3
      BB <- rep(CampNormTbl9_1[1,5],19) #soil 'b' parameter
      BD <- rep(BulkDensity,19) # soil bulk density, Mg/m3
      DD <- rep(Density,19) # soil density, Mg/m3

So for rock you make sure the bulk density is the same as the density (try just a tiny bit lower - can't remember if problems arise if they are exactly the same), turn off the soil moisture model and choose the mineral soil properties (Thcond, SpecHeat, Density) to match your rock type.

All the best,
Mike
